text: We came in for Sunday brunch after hearing a lot of hype, and honestly it just didn't live up to it. We waited about thirty minutes even with a reservation, which wouldn't have been a big deal if the food had been worth it. My eggs Benedict came out lukewarm and the hollandaise had that thick, sitting-under-a-heat-lamp texture. My husband's chicken and waffles were better, but the waffle was a little soggy in the middle. Our server was friendly but clearly stretched thin, and we had to ask twice for coffee refills. The mimosas were decent. I'd maybe give it another shot on a weekday, but not for brunch.

We tried this place for the first time last weekend and it will definitely be the last. We were seated quickly but then sat for twenty minutes before anyone came to take our order. The appetizer came out cold and the burger I ordered medium was well done and dry. When I mentioned it to the server she just shrugged and said the kitchen was busy. No apology, no offer to fix it. The bathroom was also pretty dirty. For what we paid, I expected a lot more. Save your money and go literally anywhere else.

My fiancé and I have been here a few times now and we absolutely love it. The atmosphere is cozy without being cramped, and the staff always makes us feel welcome, like regulars even though we only come every couple of months. The short rib is incredible, fall-apart tender with a rich sauce that I could honestly drink. Their seasonal cocktails are always creative and well balanced. Last time we mentioned it was our anniversary and they brought out a little dessert with a candle, which was such a sweet touch. Prices are fair for the quality. This has become our go-to spot for special nights out and we already have our next visit planned.

My husband and I came here ready to spend some serious money on a nice dinner for our anniversary, and we left feeling ripped off. The host seated us right next to the kitchen doors even though half the dining room was empty. Our server barely spoke to us and disappeared for long stretches. The $60 steak was overcooked and under seasoned, and the sides were tiny. When we asked for the manager, he was dismissive and told us that's how the chef prepares it. For the prices they charge, the service and food should be flawless. We won't be back and won't be recommending it to anyone.

This is easily one of the least friendly clubs I've been to in Vegas. The bouncers at the door were rude from the start and made our group wait forever even though the line wasn't long. Once we finally got in, the bartenders acted like taking our order was a huge inconvenience. Drinks were insanely overpriced, even by Strip standards. The music was decent and the space itself looks nice, which is the only reason I'm not giving one star. But the overall vibe was cold and kind of hostile. There are way better options in town if you want to actually have fun.

I cannot say enough good things about Copyfast. I needed a rush order of brochures and posters for a work event and they came through in a big way. The staff took the time to walk me through paper options and even caught a typo in my file before printing, which saved me a lot of embarrassment. Everything was ready a day earlier than promised and the print quality was outstanding, with crisp colors and clean cuts on every piece. Pricing was very reasonable compared to the bigger chain stores I've used before. It's clear they genuinely care about their customers and take pride in their work. I'll be bringing all of my printing projects here from now on and have already recommended them to coworkers.

I had been looking forward to my cheat meal all week and decided Pink Box was going to be it. What a letdown. I got there about an hour before closing and the case was half empty, which I get, but what was left looked tired and stale. I picked out a few donuts anyway, including their signature pink one, and the dough was dense and dry like it had been sitting out since the morning. The glaze was sickly sweet with no real flavor. The girl at the counter was on her phone the whole time and barely acknowledged me. For the prices they charge, I expected something special. I ended up throwing half of it away. If I'm going to waste calories, they need to be worth it, and these definitely weren't. Not going back.

Finally checked out Twin Peaks after driving past it for months. I knew going in that it's more about the atmosphere than the food, but I was hoping it would at least be decent. The beer was cold and they had a good selection on tap, so that's a plus. The wings, though, were small and the sauce was pretty bland. My burger was fine, nothing memorable. Service started off friendly but got slow once it got busy, and we waited a long time for our check. It was also really loud, hard to have a conversation. It's an okay place to watch a game with friends, but I wouldn't go out of my way to come back for a meal.

Stopped in after a long shift at work and I was absolutely starving. The guy at the counter was super friendly and recommended the brisket sandwich, and wow, great call. The meat was smoky, juicy, and piled high, and the bun was soft and toasted just right. The fries were crispy and perfectly salted. Everything came out fast, which I really appreciated after a ten hour day. The place was clean and had a relaxed vibe. Prices are very fair for the portion size. I left full and happy. This is going to be my new spot after work for sure.

Worst buffalo wings I've ever had, and I've eaten a lot of wings. They were tiny, overcooked, and drowning in a sauce that tasted like straight vinegar with zero heat. The celery was limp and the blue cheese dressing was clearly from a bottle. We waited forty minutes for our food even though the place was half empty. When I mentioned to the server that the wings were dry, she just said sorry and walked away. Save your money and go somewhere that actually knows what they're doing.

The entertainment was great, the food was solid, and the staff was friendly, so I really wanted to like this place more than I did. The problem was everything else. We had a reservation and still waited forty five minutes to be seated. Our drinks took forever and one order was wrong. The noise level was so high we could barely hear each other. And the bill was way higher than expected because of fees nobody mentioned. Good parts, bad overall experience.

We needed somewhere convenient and relatively cheap to eat inside the Cosmopolitan, and this spot fit the bill. It's right across from Marquee, so it's an easy stop before a night out. The menu has a decent variety, burgers, sandwiches, salads, and some breakfast items. I got the turkey club and it was fine, nothing special but filling, and the fries were good. My friend's burger was a little overcooked. Prices are reasonable for a Strip casino, which is honestly the main selling point. Service was quick but a bit impersonal, and the seating area gets crowded and loud at peak times. If you're looking for a memorable meal, this isn't it. But if you just need something quick and affordable before heading out, it does the job. Three stars feels about right.

I had no idea returning something could be so complicated. I bought a lamp here that turned out to be the wrong size, still in the box with the receipt, less than a week later. The cashier had to call a manager, who then asked me a bunch of questions like I was trying to scam them. They finally said they could only give store credit, which wasn't posted anywhere at checkout. The whole process took over twenty minutes. The store itself has nice stuff and the prices are fair, which is the only reason for two stars, but I'll think twice before buying anything here again.

Very overpriced for the quality of the food. We came here for dinner after reading some good reviews and were really disappointed. My salmon was dry and flavorless, served with a few limp vegetables and a scoop of mashed potatoes that tasted like they came from a box. My husband ordered the ribeye medium rare and got it well done. When we told the server, she took it back and it came out twenty five minutes later, after I had already finished eating. No apology from the kitchen, no discount offered. The drinks were also weak for the price. The ambiance is nice, I'll give them that, but nice lighting doesn't make up for mediocre food and poor service. Our bill was over $120 for two people and I left feeling like we got ripped off. There are so many better restaurants in the area for the same price or less.

The hostess took our name and told us it would be about ten minutes, and suggested we wait at the bar. Forty minutes later we were still sitting there, watching other groups who came in after us get seated. When I asked, she just said they were a bit behind. Once we finally sat down, the food was actually pretty good. The pasta was fresh and the garlic bread was great. But our server was clearly overwhelmed and we had to flag him down for everything. The food deserves better than two stars, but the experience overall was frustrating.

Worst sandwich I've had in a long time. I ordered the Italian sub and the bread was stale and hard, like it had been sitting out all day. There was barely any meat on it, maybe two thin slices of salami and some sad looking ham. The lettuce was wilted and the tomatoes were pale and mealy. For almost twelve dollars, I expected way more. The guy behind the counter seemed annoyed that I was even there. I took two bites and threw the rest away. Never again.

This is hands down the best Italian market in Arizona! As someone who grew up in Chicago, I've been searching for a place like this ever since I moved here, and I finally found it. Walking in, you're greeted by the smell of fresh bread and cured meats, and it instantly feels like home. Their deli counter is incredible, with real mortadella, prosciutto, and capicola sliced to order. The Italian beef sandwich is the closest I've had to the real thing since leaving Chicago, juicy and loaded with giardiniera. They also have a great selection of imported pastas, olive oils, and cheeses you can't find at regular grocery stores. The staff is warm and knowledgeable, and they always remember my order. Prices are fair for the quality. If you miss authentic Italian delis from back home, do yourself a favor and stop by. You will not be disappointed!

When my friends and I walked into Coyote Ugly in Vegas, the first thing that caught our attention was the wall of bras hanging near the dance floor and from the ceiling. It definitely sets the tone for the night. The bartenders put on a fun show, dancing on the bar and pulling people up to join them, which was entertaining for a while. The music was loud and mostly classic rock and country, which fit the vibe. Drinks were expensive and pretty weak though, and the place got so packed that it was hard to move or get served. The crowd was a mix of tourists and bachelorette parties, so it can get a little rowdy. It's a fun place to stop by once for the experience, but I don't think I'd come back. Worth a quick visit if you're nearby, just don't expect much beyond the novelty.

Went in and tried the pork ribs and the fatty brisket, and both were pretty good. The ribs had a nice bark and pulled off the bone easily, though they could have used a little more smoke flavor. The brisket was the star, tender and juicy with a great peppery crust. Sides were solid, the mac and cheese was creamy and the cornbread was slightly sweet. The only downside is they ran out of a few items by early evening, so get there early. Service was friendly and quick. I'll definitely be back to try the pulled pork.

Tried this restaurant after church today and we will definitely be going back. We were seated right away even though it was the post-service rush, which was a nice surprise. Our server was friendly and attentive and checked on us without hovering. I had the chicken fried steak and it was crispy, tender, and smothered in a really flavorful gravy. My husband got the breakfast platter and said the eggs and bacon were cooked perfectly. The biscuits were warm and fluffy and the kids loved the pancakes. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that the coffee was a bit weak and the place got pretty loud as it filled up. Prices were very reasonable for the amount of food. It has a comfortable, homey feel and it seems like a lot of families make it their Sunday tradition. We might just make it ours too.

Broken Dagger is an excellent shop to go to if you want to get off the Strip for tattoos. I came in with a rough idea for a forearm piece and the artist took the time to talk through it with me and sketch out a design that was way better than what I had imagined. The shop is super clean and everything was sterile and opened in front of me, which I always look for. The vibe is relaxed and welcoming, not intimidating at all, even for someone who doesn't have much ink. The linework is clean and the shading came out smooth. Pricing was fair and they were upfront about it before we started. It healed beautifully and I've gotten a ton of compliments on it. If you're in Vegas and want quality work from people who actually care, this is the place. I'm already planning my next piece here.

Where do I even start. We waited almost an hour for our food, and when it finally came, half our order was wrong. The chicken was dry and the fries were cold. Our server disappeared for most of the meal and we had to go up to the counter just to get refills. When we complained, the manager was rude and acted like we were the problem. The place was also dirty, sticky tables and overflowing trash cans. Never coming back.

I was very impressed with my overall experience at the JW Marriott. From the moment we pulled up, the valet and front desk staff were warm and welcoming, and check-in was quick and easy. Our room was spacious, spotless, and had a beautiful view. The bed was incredibly comfortable and I slept better than I do at home. The pool area was relaxing and well maintained, and the staff there were attentive without being intrusive. We had dinner at the hotel restaurant one night and the food was excellent. Every employee we interacted with was friendly and genuinely seemed to care. I would definitely stay here again.

I have a love hate relationship with this place. On one hand, the food is consistently good. Their tacos are some of the best in the area, the carnitas especially, and the salsa bar has a great variety. Prices are reasonable and portions are generous. On the other hand, the service is a total gamble. Some days the staff are friendly and quick, other days you wait twenty minutes just to order while employees chat behind the counter. They've gotten my order wrong more times than I can count, usually forgetting something or swapping the meat. The dining area is often messy, with tables that haven't been wiped down. Parking is also a nightmare during lunch. I keep coming back because the food is good enough to make up for it most of the time, but I always leave a little frustrated. If they could get the service consistent, this would easily be a four or five star spot.

When I moved to Arizona about five years ago, this Zipps was right down the road and quickly became one of my regular hangouts. It's a solid neighborhood sports bar with tons of TVs, so it's great for watching games. The wings are the main reason I keep coming back, they're crispy and the sauces have good flavor, especially the hot and the garlic parmesan. The burgers are decent too. Happy hour prices are great and the beer is always cold. Service can get a little slow when it's packed during big games, but the staff is friendly. It's not fancy, but it's a reliable spot to grab food and drinks.

best ramen I've had in a long time. the broth is rich and creamy, you can tell they simmer it for hours, and the noodles have the perfect chew. I got the tonkotsu with an extra egg and the egg was perfectly jammy. the pork belly literally melted in my mouth. portions are generous and the price is fair. the place is small so there's usually a wait, but it moves fast and is totally worth it. staff was friendly and quick. already planning my next visit to try the spicy miso.

I've always hung out at the bar area here, and it's great, with delicious drinks and a fun atmosphere, so that's where my four stars come from. This time, though, we bought a Groupon dinner for two and I have to say I wasn't impressed with the dining experience. The appetizer was fine, but my entree came out lukewarm and the portion seemed smaller than what other tables were getting. It felt like Groupon customers were treated a little differently. Our server was nice but slow. I'll definitely keep coming back for the bar and cocktails, but I'd skip the deal dinner next time.

My family decided to have dinner here on Easter Sunday and it was a complete disaster. We made a reservation for six people weeks in advance and still waited over forty minutes to be seated. Once we sat down, it took another twenty minutes for anyone to even bring us water. Half of the menu items were unavailable, including the ham special they advertised for the holiday. The food that did come out was cold and bland. My mother's prime rib was gray and tough. Our server seemed overwhelmed and never came back to check on us. When we asked to speak to the manager, he made excuses and didn't offer to fix anything. For the price we paid, this was a huge disappointment and ruined our holiday. We will not be returning.

I have to give credit to my husband for finding this place. He'd been talking about it for weeks and finally convinced me to come for date night, and I'm so glad he did. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and inviting, with soft lighting and great music playing at just the right volume. Our server was attentive and knew the menu inside and out, giving us great recommendations. We started with the burrata, which was creamy and served with perfectly charred bread. For our entrees, I had the seared scallops and my husband had the short rib. Both were cooked to perfection and full of flavor. We finished with the chocolate lava cake, which was rich and decadent without being overly sweet. The cocktails were also creative and well balanced. Everything about our evening was perfect. We will definitely be back, and I'll be recommending it to all our friends!

Found the place to be average at best. The menu looked promising, but the food didn't really deliver. My chicken sandwich was dry and the bun was a little stale, and the fries were lukewarm by the time they got to the table. My friend's salad was fine but pretty basic for the price. Service was friendly enough, but slow, and we had to ask twice for refills. The space is clean and has a nice patio, which is the main reason I'd give it two stars instead of one. Not terrible, just not worth going back when there are better options nearby.

This hotel is in a pretty good location in the middle of the Strip and has a really swanky, modern design. Unfortunately, that's where the positives end. Check-in took almost an hour because only two desks were open. Our room looked nice at first glance but the bathroom had mold in the shower and the AC was loud and barely worked. Housekeeping skipped our room one day completely. There's also a hefty resort fee that doesn't seem to cover much. The pool was crowded and the drinks were overpriced. It looks great in photos, but the experience didn't live up to it.

Ok, let's be honest. This place gets a lot of hype and I really wanted to love it, but it just didn't deliver. We came on a Friday night and had to wait almost an hour even though they told us twenty minutes. Once we were seated, our server was friendly but clearly overwhelmed, and it took forever to get drinks. The food was hit or miss. The appetizers were actually pretty good, especially the fried calamari, but my entree was lukewarm and the pasta was overcooked. My friend's steak was cooked well done instead of medium. When we mentioned it, they did offer to remake it, but by then we were all mostly done eating. Prices are on the high side for the quality you get. The atmosphere is nice and lively, which is about the only reason I'm giving two stars instead of one. I probably won't be back.

This is hands down the most incompetent pharmacy I've ever dealt with. My doctor sent over my prescription three days ago and every time I called they said it wasn't ready, then that they never received it, then that it needed prior authorization, which my insurance confirmed it didn't. When I finally showed up in person, I waited forty five minutes in line just to be told they were out of stock. The staff seemed completely disorganized and nobody could give a straight answer. I've transferred all my prescriptions elsewhere. Avoid this place if you actually need your medication on time.

Very loud, boisterous, and bustling, and thankfully we had a reservation, because the place was packed. Even with all the noise, we had a great evening here. Our server was fantastic, friendly and attentive without hovering, and he gave us some great recommendations. The food and drinks came out in a timely manner, and there wasn't a single dish we didn't enjoy. The short rib was tender and flavorful, and the roasted vegetables were perfectly seasoned. Cocktails were creative and well made. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is the noise level, it was hard to have a conversation at times. Still, I'd definitely come back.

A wee bit touristy, but a beautiful and elegant pub and restaurant just steps away from our hostel on the Royal Mile. The interior is gorgeous, with dark wood, stained glass, and cozy little nooks that make it feel like a proper old Edinburgh pub. We came in for dinner on a rainy evening and it was the perfect spot to warm up. I had the haggis, neeps and tatties, which was hearty and well seasoned, and my friend had the fish and chips, which were crispy and generously portioned. They also have a great selection of Scottish ales and whiskies, and the bartender was happy to make recommendations. Service was friendly, although a bit slow once the place filled up. Prices are slightly higher than other pubs nearby, which I expected given the location. Overall, a lovely experience and a great place to try traditional Scottish food. I'd happily return.

Fun place to watch the game, with tons of TVs and a lively crowd, but the food just isn't that impressive and it's pretty pricey for what you get. The wings were small and a little soggy, and the nachos were mostly chips with a few toppings scattered on top. Drinks were good but expensive. Service was friendly but slow when it got busy. I'd come back for a big game with friends, but I'd probably eat somewhere else first.

I really want to love this place, but I just can't. The decor is cute and the menu sounds amazing, but the execution falls short every time. My pasta was overcooked and the sauce was bland, and my friend's chicken was dry. Service is friendly but painfully slow, even when it's not busy. The prices are a bit high for what you get. I've given it a few chances hoping it would improve, and it's not bad, just consistently mediocre. I'll probably only come back for drinks on the patio, which is honestly the best part.

This place is a complete joke. We waited 45 minutes for a table even though half the restaurant was empty. The server was rude and acted like we were bothering her every time we asked for something. My burger came out raw in the middle and the fries were cold and soggy. When I asked to speak to a manager, he just shrugged and said there was nothing he could do. The bathrooms were filthy too. Absolutely terrible experience from start to finish. Do yourself a favor and go anywhere else. I will never be back.

Wow. Just wow. I've been to a lot of restaurants in this city, but this place blew me away. Every dish we ordered was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The scallops were seared perfectly and the risotto was creamy and rich. Our server was attentive, friendly, and had great recommendations. The cocktails were creative and delicious. The atmosphere is cozy and perfect for date night. It's a bit pricey, but completely worth it. I can't wait to come back!

Great place for people watching, although it's a bit pricey, but they really struggle when it comes to gluten-free options. As someone with celiac, I was excited to try it, but the server had no idea which menu items were safe and had to keep checking with the kitchen. In the end, my only real option was a plain salad with oil and vinegar, which was pretty disappointing for the price. My friends enjoyed their food and the drinks were good, and the patio has a fun, lively vibe. If you don't have dietary restrictions, you'll probably have a better time, but I won't be coming back.

This car wash gets the exterior done nicely and quickly, and I come here pretty often because the location is convenient. The automatic wash does a good job on the outside and the free vacuums are a nice bonus. However, the interior service is hit or miss. Sometimes the windows still have streaks and the dashboard barely gets wiped. The staff is friendly, but they seem rushed during busy times. Prices are fair. It's fine for a quick wash, but I wouldn't count on it for a thorough detail.

The Murrayfield area of town has a small strip of shops, including the usual newsagent, and this café sits right in the middle of them. It's a decent spot for a coffee and a quick bite if you're in the neighbourhood. The coffee was fine, nothing special, and my scone was a bit dry, although the jam helped. The staff were friendly but seemed a bit overwhelmed when a few people came in at once. Seating is limited and it can get cramped. Prices are reasonable. It's convenient, but I wouldn't go out of my way to visit.

Humble Pie at Desert Ridge is great, so I was excited when this location opened much closer to my home. Unfortunately, it's nothing like the other one. We waited 30 minutes for a table even though there were several empty ones. The pizza came out lukewarm with a soggy crust, and the salad was wilted. Our server disappeared for most of the meal and never refilled our drinks. When we mentioned the issues to the manager, he didn't seem to care. I'll just make the drive to Desert Ridge from now on.

The doctors at Desert Family have been good in my experience, but the front office staff is a completely different story. I've had multiple appointments where I've waited over an hour past my scheduled time with no explanation. When I called to ask about a billing error, I was put on hold for twenty minutes and then transferred to a voicemail that was full. The receptionists are rude and act like you're bothering them. They also lost my referral paperwork twice. It's honestly not worth the stress, even with good doctors. I've switched to a different practice.

I feel like I'm jumping on the bandwagon here, but why not? This place deserves every bit of praise it gets. I actually never bring my kids here because it's my little escape from the chaos, and it never disappoints. The atmosphere is calm and cozy, the staff is incredibly friendly, and they always remember my order. The coffee is consistently excellent, smooth and rich without any bitterness, and their lavender latte is my absolute favorite. The pastries are baked fresh every morning and the almond croissant is honestly the best I've had outside of Paris. They also have plenty of comfortable seating, good Wi-Fi, and outlets, so it's easy to settle in with a book or get some work done. Prices are reasonable for the quality. This is my happy place and I can't recommend it enough. Five stars, no question.

I had a tire throw its tread the other day in the extreme heat, so I limped in here for a used replacement. Big mistake. They quoted me one price and then tacked on mystery fees at the end. The tire they put on had a slow leak, and when I came back the next day, they told me it was my problem since it was used. The guy at the counter was rude and wouldn't even look at it. I ended up having to buy a new tire somewhere else. Stay away from this place and save yourself the headache.

We came here for brunch on a Saturday and were pretty disappointed. We waited about 40 minutes for a table, which would have been fine if the food was worth it. My eggs Benedict came out lukewarm and the hollandaise was thick and bland. My friend's pancakes were dry and the bacon was overcooked. Our server was nice but clearly overwhelmed, and we had to ask multiple times for coffee refills. The mimosas were decent and the atmosphere is cute, which is why I'm giving two stars. I probably won't be coming back.

We went here with a big group and were seated right away, which was great. Unfortunately, things went downhill from there. It took almost twenty minutes for our server to come take drink orders, and then the food came out in waves, so half of us were finished before the others even got their plates. Two orders were wrong and one never came at all. The food that did arrive was just okay, nothing special. My burger was dry and the fries were lukewarm. The server seemed overwhelmed and wasn't very apologetic. I appreciate them accommodating a large party, but I probably won't be back.

The Cooper's Tavern has become one of my go-to spots to recommend to Madison visitors and locals alike. The atmosphere is cozy and lively, with a great beer list and solid cocktails. The food is consistently good, especially the burger and the fish and chips. Service is friendly and generally quick, though it can get slow when it's packed on weekends. Prices are reasonable for being right on the Square. A great place to grab a drink and a bite.

The food is good and the portions are huge, if you can actually get someone to bring it to you. We waited forever for our order, and once it arrived, getting a coffee refill was nearly impossible. I asked for more syrup for my pancakes and got a tiny cup that barely covered one bite. Our server disappeared for long stretches. The pancakes and bacon were tasty, but the slow, inattentive service really ruined the experience. Two stars for the food alone.

We tried Curry on Murray last week and were sadly disappointed. We'd heard great things, so maybe our expectations were too high. The chicken tikka masala was okay, but the sauce was a little too sweet and lacked any real depth. The naan was soft and fresh, which was a highlight. Service was friendly but slow, and the restaurant felt a bit dated. Prices were fair for the portion sizes. It wasn't a bad meal, just not memorable. We might give it another try, but it's not at the top of our list.

The food, the ambience, and the service are all amazing! We'd been here once before but sat in a booth, and I wanted to have a second experience before writing a review. This time we sat on the patio and it was even better. The lighting and music set the perfect mood for date night. Our server was warm, attentive, and gave great suggestions. We started with the burrata and the grilled octopus, both incredible. My filet was cooked perfectly and the mashed potatoes were rich and buttery. My husband's salmon was flaky and flavorful. We ended with the tiramisu, which was the best I've had in a long time. Every visit has been fantastic and I can't wait to come back!

Awesome service! Our waiter was fun, efficient, and had great recommendations when we asked what to try. We started with the calamari, which was crispy and tender, and the spinach artichoke dip was creamy and full of flavor. For dinner I had the grilled salmon with seasonal vegetables, cooked perfectly, and my wife had the chicken parmesan, which was a huge portion. The drinks were good and reasonably priced. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that it was pretty loud and our table was a little cramped. Overall, a great experience, and we'll definitely be back. Ask for Mike if you can!

My negative experience with Sharona Optical and their affiliated Horizon Eye Specialists has been too long and involved to describe in full without boring everyone, so here's the short version. They lost my prescription, charged me twice for the same exam, and took three weeks to order glasses that turned out to be the wrong lenses. Every phone call was met with transfers and excuses, and no one took responsibility. When I asked for a refund, I was told it would take up to sixty days. Avoid them.

Apparently we went at a bad time, but that's really no excuse for the experience we had. We arrived around 7 on a Saturday night and the place was packed, which we expected. What we didn't expect was to wait over an hour for a table even though we had a reservation. Once seated, it took another twenty minutes for our server to come by and take our drink order. The food took almost an hour to come out, and when it did, my steak was overcooked and my husband's pasta was lukewarm. When we told the server, she just shrugged and said the kitchen was slammed. No apology, no offer to fix it, nothing. The manager never came by either. For the prices they charge, this was completely unacceptable. We won't be back.

I wouldn't go out of my way to come back here again, but the little White Castle style sliders do have good flavor. They're juicy, nicely seasoned, and the grilled onions add a nice touch. The problem is everything else. The fries were limp and lukewarm, and the shakes were thin and overly sweet. The service was slow even though there were only a few people in line, and they got our order wrong. The dining area also wasn't very clean, with sticky tables and an overflowing trash can. Prices are fair for the portions, so it's not a terrible value. If you're in the area and craving sliders, it's fine, but I'd probably try somewhere else next time. Three stars mainly for the burgers.

After spending the morning at the protest up on the square, my friends and I wandered down State Street looking for something to eat so we could refuel before heading back. We stumbled into this place and it turned out to be a great choice. Even though it was busy, they found us a table quickly and our server was friendly and patient with our big, hungry group. The food came out fast and was hearty and satisfying. I had the grilled cheese with tomato soup, perfect comfort food, and my friends loved their burgers and sweet potato fries. Prices were reasonable, especially for being so close to campus. The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, and nobody seemed to mind our signs propped up against the wall. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that it was a bit loud and cramped. Still, we left full, recharged, and ready to get back out there. Would definitely return.

Resort??? I don't think so. We booked this place for a long weekend getaway based on the photos and description, and it was a huge disappointment. The lobby looked nice, but that's where it ended. Our room smelled musty, the carpet was stained, and the bathroom had mold around the tub. The air conditioning barely worked, which was a real problem in the summer heat. The pool was overcrowded and the water was cloudy. Half the amenities advertised on their website, like the spa and the poolside bar, were closed for renovations, yet we were still charged the full resort fee. When we complained to the front desk, the staff was dismissive and offered no compensation. The restaurant on site was overpriced and the food was mediocre at best. For what we paid, we could have stayed somewhere much nicer. Save your money and look elsewhere.

I purchased a Groupon, called, and made an appointment for a facial. When I arrived, the receptionist told me they had no record of my booking and that I'd have to come back another day. I explained that I had taken time off work and even showed her my confirmation text, but she just shrugged. I rescheduled for the following week, and when I showed up, I waited over thirty minutes past my appointment time. The facial itself was rushed and the esthetician barely spoke to me. At the end, they tried to upsell me on expensive products and seemed annoyed when I declined. They also tacked on an extra fee that wasn't mentioned anywhere in the Groupon. The whole experience was unprofessional and frustrating. I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. Save your money.

I've come here a few times for waxing and they've always been thorough and far less painful than other places I've tried. The estheticians are professional, friendly, and make you feel comfortable right away, which really matters for something like this. The rooms are clean and private, and they use a gentle hard wax that doesn't leave my skin red or irritated afterward. They work quickly but never rush, and they always check in to make sure I'm okay. Booking online is easy and they're usually on time. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that the prices are a little higher than some other spots in the area, and the front desk can be a bit disorganized when it's busy. Still, for the quality and comfort, I think it's worth it. I'll keep coming back.

Stopped by this Subway on the drive back to Vegas from Phoenix. It's a convenient stop off the highway and was fairly clean inside. The staff was friendly, but there was only one person working, so the line moved slowly. My sandwich was fine, the bread was fresh but they were out of a few veggies, including spinach and cucumbers. The bathroom wasn't great. Prices are what you'd expect. Nothing special, but it does the job when you're on the road and need something quick. If you're passing through and hungry, it's a decent option, just expect a wait during the lunch rush.

Yen has amazing sushi! Everything we ordered was incredibly fresh and beautifully presented. The salmon and yellowtail practically melted in my mouth, and their specialty rolls are creative without being overloaded with sauce. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the chefs clearly take pride in their work. Prices are very reasonable for the quality. The atmosphere is cozy and relaxed. This has quickly become our favorite sushi spot and we'll definitely be back soon!

So, let me start by saying I was a bit skeptical coming in, since I'd read mixed reviews. But I'm glad I gave it a chance. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, with friendly staff who greeted us right away. We were seated quickly and our server was attentive without hovering. I ordered the chicken marsala and it was rich and flavorful, with perfectly cooked mushrooms. My partner had the lasagna, which was hearty and cheesy. The bread was warm and fresh. The only downside was that our entrees took a little longer than expected to come out, and the dessert menu was limited. Prices are reasonable for the portion sizes. Overall, it was a solid experience and I'd definitely come back to try more of the menu.

My review on this place is a bit mixed. On the positive side, the food is genuinely good. I ordered the chicken shawarma plate and it was flavorful and well seasoned, and the garlic sauce was amazing. My friend got the falafel wrap and liked it as well. Portions are generous and the prices are fair for what you get. However, the service needs some work. We waited almost fifteen minutes just to place our order even though there were only a couple of people ahead of us, and the staff seemed disorganized behind the counter. One of our orders came out wrong and it took a while to get it fixed. The dining area also wasn't very clean, and several tables still had crumbs and trash on them. I'd come back for the food, but I'd probably get it to go next time. If they improve the service and cleanliness, this could easily be a four or five star spot.

I'm about as white as it gets and showed up on Latin night not knowing what to expect, but I had a blast. The music was great and the crowd was super friendly, even when I clearly had no idea what I was doing on the dance floor. A couple of people even gave me a quick salsa lesson. Drinks were strong and reasonably priced. It got pretty packed later in the night, so the bar was a little slow, but overall it was a fun night. I'd definitely go back.

We have been to Nosh several times for both dinner and brunch and have never been disappointed. The menu is creative but still approachable, and everything we've tried has been delicious. Their brunch is a highlight, especially the chicken and waffles and the lemon ricotta pancakes. For dinner, the short ribs and the seasonal salads are fantastic. Service is always friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming. Prices are very reasonable for the quality. It's one of our favorite spots in town and we always recommend it to friends.

Over the past few years, they've remodeled and repositioned this property to appeal to a younger crowd, and it shows. The lobby is now sleek and modern, with a lively bar and DJ on weekends, and the pool area has been turned into more of a party scene. If that's what you're looking for, you'll probably enjoy it. Our room was updated and stylish, with a comfortable bed and nice bathroom fixtures. However, the noise from the pool and bar carried into the room late into the night, making it hard to sleep. Service was friendly but inconsistent, and check-in took longer than expected. The resort fee is also steep for what it includes. Overall, it's a decent stay if you want a fun atmosphere, but if you're looking for peace and quiet, there are better options nearby.

Another comped dinner, and this time I was sober enough to remember that we really didn't eat that much. The steak was decent but nothing special, and the sides were tiny for the price. Our server seemed annoyed that we were on a comp and rushed us through the meal. The wine list is overpriced, and the bill would have been outrageous if we'd been paying. Even for free, I wasn't impressed. The atmosphere is nice, but the food and service just don't match the hype. I wouldn't spend my own money here.

This is a great spot for a date night. The atmosphere is warm and intimate, with dim lighting and soft music that makes it easy to have a conversation. We started with a couple of cocktails, which were creative and well made. For dinner, I had the seared salmon and my partner had the short rib, and both dishes were full of flavor and cooked perfectly. The portions were just right and the presentation was beautiful. Our server was friendly and attentive without being intrusive. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that it's a bit pricey and the dessert menu was limited. Still, we really enjoyed our evening and will definitely be back.

This is my first review after my first visit to the newest Picazzo's in the West Valley. The restaurant is clean and modern, and the staff was very friendly and welcoming. I appreciate that they have a lot of gluten-free and healthier options on the menu. We tried the Mediterranean pizza and a salad, and both were fresh and full of flavor. The crust was crispy and light. Service was a little slow since it was a busy night, but our server was apologetic and attentive. I'll definitely be back.

I recently had a cupcake cake made here for my son's fourth birthday and it was absolutely perfect! I came in with a vague idea of a dinosaur theme and the staff helped me design something even better than I imagined. The decorating was adorable and so detailed, and the kids went crazy over it. Best of all, the cupcakes were moist and delicious, and the frosting wasn't overly sweet. It was ready on time and priced very reasonably. The staff was friendly and helpful throughout the whole process. I'll definitely be ordering here again for future birthdays!

I will never be coming back here ever!!!! I made an appointment with my regular nail tech, and when I showed up, she wasn't even there. Nobody called to let me know. Instead, they put me with someone else who rushed through my manicure and was rough the entire time. She cut my cuticles too much and one of my fingers started bleeding. The polish was uneven and already chipping the next day. When I complained, the manager said there was nothing she could do and still charged me full price. She was also rude and dismissive the whole time. The place was crowded and loud, and it didn't feel very clean. I've been a loyal customer here for over a year and spent a lot of money, and this is how they treat me. Very disappointed. I'll be taking my business somewhere else and I definitely won't recommend this salon to any of my friends or family.

I must be a bakery snob, because I wasn't as blown away as I expected to be after all the hype. Don't get me wrong, the pastries here are good. The croissant was flaky and buttery, and the cinnamon roll had great flavor. However, a few items tasted a bit dry, like they'd been sitting out too long. The staff was friendly and the shop is cute and cozy. Prices are on the higher side. I'd still come back, but I don't think it lives up to all the hype.

The only reason I'm giving two stars is that the girl who took my order was very friendly and helpful. She was patient while I figured out what I wanted and made a couple of great suggestions. Unfortunately, everything else was disappointing. The food took forever to come out even though it wasn't busy, and when it finally arrived my burger was overcooked and the fries were cold. My friend's chicken sandwich was dry and bland. The tables were dirty and the trash was overflowing. For the price, I expected a lot more. I appreciate the great service from the cashier, but I probably won't be coming back.

The service was pathetic. We were there for two hours and only got a few of the dishes we ordered. Our server disappeared for long stretches and never once checked on us. When we finally flagged someone down to ask about the rest of our food, they said the kitchen had lost our ticket. No apology, no offer to comp anything, nothing. The food that did come out was lukewarm and bland. We ended up just paying for what we got and leaving hungry. Absolutely terrible experience and I would not recommend this place to anyone.

Get there around 10:30 and you get the best of both worlds, the tail end of breakfast and the beginning of lunch. That's exactly what we did and it worked out great, although they were out of a couple of breakfast items by then. I had the breakfast burrito, which was huge and well seasoned, and my friend ordered the BLT from the lunch menu, which she said was good but nothing special. The coffee was decent and refills were frequent. Service was friendly, but it did get busy and a bit chaotic as the lunch crowd started to show up. The space is small and the tables are close together, so it can get loud. Prices are reasonable for the portion sizes. It's a solid spot if you're in the area and can't decide between breakfast and lunch, but I don't think it's worth going out of your way for. Three stars feels about right.

I was excited to try their menu for the first time at the Cabarrus County Food Truck Friday, but I was really disappointed. The line was long, which I expected, but it took almost forty five minutes after ordering to get my food. When it finally came, my brisket tacos were lukewarm and the tortillas were dry and falling apart. The meat had very little flavor and was mostly fat. The prices were also pretty high for the portion size. The staff seemed overwhelmed and disorganized, and they didn't even apologize for the wait. I really wanted to love this place, but I won't be ordering from them again.

The crepes here were a bit odd. I ordered a savory ham and cheese crepe and it came out thick and rubbery, more like a pancake than a crepe. The filling was okay, but there wasn't much of it. My friend's Nutella crepe was better, but still nothing special. The staff was friendly and the place is cute and cozy. Prices are reasonable. It's not bad, but I've definitely had better crepes elsewhere.

How on earth have I not reviewed this gem yet! Don't be fooled by how it looks from the outside, because this little spot is one of the best hidden treasures in town. The food is consistently amazing, made fresh, and full of flavor. I usually get the pad thai or the green curry, and both are perfection every single time. The owners are so warm and welcoming and always remember my order. Portions are generous and prices are very fair. If you haven't been here yet, you're seriously missing out. Go now!

Oh, Come Back Inn, where do I even begin? We stopped in on a Friday night after hearing good things from friends, and it was one of the worst dining experiences I've had in a long time. We waited over thirty minutes for a table even though there were several empty ones in the dining room. Once we were finally seated, it took another fifteen minutes for anyone to come take our drink order. The server seemed annoyed to be there and barely spoke to us. When the food finally arrived, my burger was cold and overcooked, and my husband's fried chicken was greasy and tasted old. The fries were soggy and lukewarm. We tried to flag someone down to fix it, but no one came by for another twenty minutes. When we told the manager, he just shrugged and said the kitchen was backed up. No apology, no discount. Save your money and go somewhere else.

I planned a mystery date night for my son and daughter-in-law and this restaurant made it absolutely perfect. I called ahead and explained what I was doing, and the staff couldn't have been more helpful. They reserved a quiet corner table, had a handwritten note waiting for them, and even brought out a complimentary dessert with a candle. My son told me the food was incredible. They shared the seafood linguine and the filet, and said both were cooked to perfection. The service was warm and attentive without being intrusive, and the atmosphere was romantic and cozy. They said it was one of the best nights out they've had in a long time. I can't thank the staff enough for going above and beyond to make it special. I'll definitely be planning more surprises here!

As someone from the Philly area, driving by and seeing the sign got me pretty excited for a real cheesesteak. Unfortunately, it didn't live up to the name. The bread was soft but not the right roll, the meat was dry and under seasoned, and the cheese barely melted. It just tasted like a generic steak sandwich. The fries were decent and the staff was friendly. Prices are a little high for what you get. Not the worst, but definitely not authentic.

So far I've been here three times with my husband and we've enjoyed every visit. The food is consistently good, and the portions are generous. My favorite is the chicken marsala, which is rich and flavorful, and my husband loves their lasagna. The bread they bring out at the start is warm and delicious. Service has always been friendly and attentive, and our server last time gave us great wine recommendations. The atmosphere is cozy and comfortable, perfect for a casual date night. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that it can get pretty loud on weekends and the wait can be long without a reservation. Overall, it's a great spot and we'll definitely keep coming back.

I've always been a fan of this place because it's just about the only spot to get ramen in the valley, and their ramen is pretty tasty. The broth is rich and flavorful, and the noodles have a nice chew to them. I usually get the tonkotsu with an extra egg, and it hits the spot on a cold day. However, the last couple of visits have been a bit inconsistent. One time the broth was lukewarm, and another time the pork was dry and fatty. Service can also be slow, especially when it gets busy, and it's easy to wait a while just to get your check. The place is small, so seating is limited during peak hours. Prices have gone up a bit too. I'll still come back when I'm craving ramen, but I wish they'd get things more consistent.

I've been eating at this restaurant for quite a while now, and I've never had a bad experience or a bad dish. The food is consistently fresh, flavorful, and well prepared. My go-to is the chicken curry, which has a great depth of flavor, but I've also loved the noodle dishes and their spring rolls. The staff is always friendly and welcoming, and service is quick even when it's busy. Prices are very reasonable for the portion sizes. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that the dining area is a bit small and can get cramped during peak hours. Still, it's one of my favorite spots and I keep coming back.

I visited Hana with friends on a recent trip to Phoenix and it was one of the best meals of our whole trip. The sushi was incredibly fresh and beautifully presented, and every roll we tried was delicious. The staff was warm and attentive, and it's BYOB, which was a nice bonus. Prices were very reasonable for the quality. I'll definitely be back the next time I'm in town!

I'm not usually one to pay double to get my oil changed in fifteen minutes, but a couple of times, like before a road trip, I've had no choice. The convenience is nice, but that's about it. Both times, the technicians tried to upsell me on air filters, wiper blades, and a transmission flush I didn't need. The last time, they forgot to put the oil cap back on tight, and I noticed a leak a few days later. When I brought it back, they were apologetic but acted like it wasn't a big deal. The waiting area is clean, and they really are quick. But for the price, I expect better quality and less pressure. I'll stick to my regular mechanic unless I'm really in a pinch.

Crapplebee's. That's what my friends and I have started calling it, but honestly it's not as bad as the name suggests. It's exactly what you'd expect from a chain restaurant, nothing more, nothing less. The food is average, the boneless wings and riblets were fine, and the mozzarella sticks were decent. My burger was a little overcooked and the fries were lukewarm. The drinks are cheap during happy hour, which is a big plus. Service was friendly but slow, and we had to flag down our server a couple of times. The restaurant was fairly clean, but the booths are showing their age. If you're looking for something cheap and familiar, it gets the job done. Just don't expect anything special. Three stars for consistency and the happy hour deals.

Hot pot, which is kind of like an Asian version of fondue, is more about the social experience than the food, and this place definitely felt that way. It's fun to sit around the table with friends and cook everything yourself, but the quality of the ingredients was disappointing. The meat was thinly sliced but seemed frozen and a bit freezer burned, and the vegetables weren't very fresh. The broth options were limited and the spicy one had a lot of heat but not much flavor. Service was slow, and we had to ask several times for refills on broth and sauces. It's also pricier than other hot pot spots in the area. It was an okay night out with friends, but I wouldn't come back for the food.

If I could give this spot 100 stars, I would. Everything about it is incredible. The food is fresh, flavorful, and made with so much care, and every dish we've tried has been a hit. The tacos al pastor are the best I've ever had, and the homemade salsas are amazing. The staff is warm and welcoming and treats you like family. Prices are super reasonable for the quality and portion sizes. It's become our go-to spot for date night and family dinners. Do yourself a favor and try it!

HORRIBLE! I was a customer of this place for several years, until new management took over a couple of years ago. Since then, everything has gone downhill. The staff is rude and unprofessional, appointments are constantly double-booked, and the quality of service has dropped significantly. My last visit, I waited forty minutes past my appointment time and was rushed through the service. When I complained, the manager was dismissive and didn't seem to care at all. I'm not coming back.

Lex was awesome! I came in for a haircut and color and was a little nervous since I'd had some bad experiences elsewhere, but Lex immediately put me at ease. She listened carefully to what I wanted, asked great questions, and even showed me some photos to make sure we were on the same page. She was so friendly and easy to talk to, and the time flew by. My color came out exactly how I imagined, rich and even with no brassiness, and the cut is perfect for my face shape. She also gave me some great tips on how to style it at home and what products to use. The salon itself is clean, modern, and relaxing. Prices are fair for the quality. I've already booked my next appointment and I'll be recommending Lex to all my friends!

You'll have to pay a lot to stay here, but if you're in Scottsdale, it's definitely one of the top places to stay. The pool is amazing, with plenty of lounge chairs and cabanas, and the staff constantly comes around with ice water and towels. The poolside food service is excellent, and the cocktails are delicious. Our room was spacious, clean, and beautifully decorated, with a super comfortable bed. Every staff member we interacted with was friendly and professional. The spa was also a highlight and worth every penny. I can't wait to come back!

This is your typical Hawaiian BBQ spot. The plate lunches are huge and filling, and the prices are pretty reasonable for the amount of food you get. The chicken katsu was crispy, and the BBQ beef was tender but a little too sweet for my taste. The macaroni salad was fine, nothing special. Service was quick and friendly. It's not the best Hawaiian food I've had, but it hits the spot when you're craving it.

Our large group walked over here from Planet Hollywood, and I'm glad we did. They were able to seat all twelve of us without a reservation after a short wait, which was impressive on a Saturday night. Our server handled our big group like a pro and kept the drinks coming. The food was really good, especially the steak tacos and the queso. A few dishes came out a little later than others, but nothing major. Prices are reasonable for the Strip. Great spot for groups.

Sometimes I'm just in the mood for some cheap, filling, hole-in-the-wall Chinese food, and this place does the trick. The portions are huge and the prices are very reasonable. I usually get the General Tso's chicken and the pork fried rice, and both are tasty, although the chicken can be a little greasy. The egg rolls are crispy and good. The service is quick, but not very friendly, and the dining area is a bit worn down and not the cleanest. It's definitely more of a takeout spot. Not the best Chinese food I've ever had, but for a quick, inexpensive meal, it does the job. I'll probably be back when the craving hits.

My lowly review probably won't make any difference to the patronage of this over-hyped, over-crowded, and over-priced tourist trap, but I'm writing it anyway. We waited almost an hour to get a table, despite being told it would be fifteen minutes. Once we were seated, the server rushed through our order and barely checked on us afterward. The food was mediocre at best. My clam chowder was lukewarm and thin, and my husband's fish and chips were greasy and bland. For the prices they charge, I expected far better quality. The view is nice, which is the only reason I'm giving it two stars. But the view doesn't make up for poor service and forgettable food. I'm sure the crowds will keep coming, but there are much better places in town for a fraction of the price. Skip this one.

This was okay, not great and not terrible. We came in for dinner on a Thursday night and were seated fairly quickly. The menu has a good variety, but nothing really stood out to me. I ordered the grilled chicken with vegetables and rice. The chicken was cooked well but lacked seasoning, and the vegetables were a bit mushy. My husband had the burger, which he said was decent but nothing special. The fries were crispy and probably the best part of the meal. Our server was friendly but seemed overwhelmed, and we had to wait a while for refills and our check. The restaurant itself is clean and has a relaxed atmosphere, which was nice. Prices were reasonable for the portion sizes. Overall, it was an average experience. I wouldn't go out of my way to come back, but if I was in the area and hungry, I wouldn't mind stopping in again.

This place mainly supplies restaurants and convenience stores, but anyone can shop here, no membership required, and the selection and quality are better than any Costco I've been to. You can find everything from bulk spices and fresh produce to restaurant-grade kitchen supplies at great prices. The meat and seafood sections are especially impressive. Staff are helpful and knowledgeable. It's a bit warehouse-like and can be busy, but it's absolutely worth it. A hidden gem!

I spoke with Joe and he was very professional and knowledgeable. I needed some new tires and a wheel alignment, but I also thought I needed a new battery because of starting issues. They checked and tested the battery and told me it was fine and just needed a cleaning on the terminals. They could have easily sold me a new one, but they were honest. Great service and fair prices. Highly recommend!

I'm not a car person at all, and Lester couldn't have been more accommodating. He took the time to explain all my options without any pressure and answered every one of my questions patiently. He even worked with me to find a car that fit my budget. The whole process was smooth and stress-free. I'd highly recommend asking for Lester if you're looking for a new car!

Pass on this place. There are better restaurants just a few steps away. The food was bland and overpriced, and our server seemed uninterested in helping us. We waited a long time for our meals, and when they came, my pasta was lukewarm. The ambiance is nice, but that's about it. I probably won't be back.

The main reason for my three star rating is that they had NO water available, not in the vending machines and not at the food counter. On a hot day, that's a pretty big oversight. Otherwise, the place itself is fine. The facilities were clean and the staff was friendly, even if they seemed a bit understaffed. The food options were limited and pricey, but what we got was decent. If they can fix the basic stuff like keeping water stocked, this would easily be a four star spot.

I gave this place a second chance and never should have!! Since the remodel, expect at least an hour wait! Horribly slow! I watched the staff stand around talking instead of working on cars. When I finally got my car back, the interior was barely vacuumed and there were still streaks on all the windows. The manager didn't seem to care when I complained. Way overpriced for terrible service. Never coming back.

This place has everything! It's a one stop shop for groceries, household goods, and even some hard to find specialty items. The produce is fresh, the prices are fair, and the aisles are clean and well organized. The staff is friendly and always willing to help you find what you need. The only downside is that it can get really crowded on weekends and the checkout lines can be long. Still, it's my go to store and I'm here at least once a week.

Stay away from the surf and turf! Unless you're okay with the "surf" being one shrimp and a tiny scallop. For the price, it was really disappointing. The steak was cooked fine, but it was small and kind of tough. The sides were bland. Our server was nice enough, but the food just wasn't worth the money. Probably won't be back.

I can't get over the process it took to get my food ordered. First, you have to stand in one line to order, then another line to pay, then wait for your number to be called, but nobody explains any of this when you walk in. It was confusing and took forever. The food itself was decent once I finally got it. My burger was juicy and the fries were crispy, though a little salty. My friend's chicken sandwich was good too. The dining area was clean and had a fun atmosphere, and the staff was friendly when you could actually get their attention. Prices are reasonable. If they could streamline the ordering process, I'd definitely give them more stars. As it is, I'd only come back if I wasn't in a rush.

I joined Mountainside when they opened and fell in love with this gym. The facility is always clean and well maintained, and there is plenty of equipment, so I rarely have to wait for anything. The classes are fantastic, especially the spin and yoga classes, and the instructors are energetic and motivating. The staff is friendly and always greets you by name. The locker rooms are spotless and have everything you need. The membership price is very reasonable for everything they offer. This gym has become my second home!

For such a thin pizza, it's really overpriced. The crust is crispy and the toppings are fresh, so I'll give them that. The sauce has a nice flavor, too. But for almost twenty dollars, I expected a lot more food. Two of us were still hungry after sharing a large. The service was friendly but a little slow. It's not bad pizza, but I don't think it's worth the price.

They dropped off menus at my office and I thought the food looked really good, so I ordered lunch for myself and a few coworkers. Huge mistake. Our order took over an hour and a half to arrive, even though they promised forty five minutes. When I called to check on it, the person who answered was rude and said the driver was on the way, which clearly wasn't true. When the food finally came, it was cold and half of it was wrong. My chicken was dry and flavorless, and the rice was hard. One of my coworkers didn't even get their order at all. When I called to complain, they refused to give us a refund or even a discount. Absolutely terrible customer service. I won't be ordering from here again and I'll be making sure my coworkers know to avoid them too.

I tried the Chinese food here and it was really bad!! The BBQ meats weren't fresh and tasted like they'd been sitting out all day. I had stomach problems after eating at their all you can eat buffet. The place wasn't clean either. Definitely not coming back.

Seriously had to meet the delivery driver at Brillobox because that was apparently the closest he "was allowed" to come to my place. I've never had that happen with any other delivery service. The food itself was okay, but it was lukewarm by the time I got it home. Customer service didn't seem to care when I complained. I won't be ordering again.

Beautiful restaurant with very good service, but the menu is too small and the food wasn't that great. Our server was attentive and friendly. I had the chicken and it was fine but a little dry. My husband's pasta was bland. The atmosphere is lovely, but the food needs improvement.

Nice decor doesn't make up for poor service and terrible hygiene. When we walked in, the restaurant looked beautiful, with modern furniture and nice lighting, but it went downhill quickly. Our server was inattentive and disappeared for long periods of time. When our food came out, my plate had a hair on it, and my friend's glass had lipstick on the rim. We asked for replacements and the server rolled her eyes. The bathroom was filthy, with no soap and paper towels everywhere. I lost my appetite completely. I will never come back.

The staff is friendly, but both times I've come to this location, the cashier, who also happens to be the manager, got my order wrong somehow. The first time they forgot my side, and the second time I got the wrong sandwich entirely. The food is okay when it's right, but I shouldn't have to double check everything before I leave. Not coming back.
